model.labels: opaque Unicode scalar sequences, never identity or credential proof
model.decision_effect: records an offline decision receipt only; performs no requested action

semantics.rule_selector: principal, resource, and action selectors are exact labels or the reserved wildcard *
semantics.capabilities: all required capability labels must be present; action order is irrelevant but duplicate labels reject
semantics.time: not_before is inclusive and expires_at is exclusive; timestamps are explicit safe integers while action-list order is authoritative and timestamps need not be monotonic
semantics.namespace: an action namespace unequal to the immutable policy namespace receives a recorded denial before rule matching
semantics.deny_overrides: any fully matching deny rule wins over every fully matching allow rule
semantics.default_deny: absence of a fully matching allow rule always denies
semantics.diagnostics: when no rule fully matches, capability, not-before, expiry, then no-match reasons apply in that order
semantics.revocation: policy_epoch below the snapshot epoch is a recorded denial; policy_epoch above it is a rejection without nonce consumption
semantics.first_use: a structurally valid unseen nonce records the resulting allow or deny decision
semantics.exact_retry: same nonce and byte-equivalent canonical request content returns the stored decision as an accepted no-op
semantics.conflict: same nonce with different canonical request content rejects before policy evaluation and mutates nothing
semantics.rejection: every rejected action has byte-identical pre-state and post-state digests

canonical_request_identity: capabilities sorted by Unicode scalar order

canonical_json.numbers: safe integers only; floats, exponent forms, negative zero, and non-finite values reject
canonical_json.strings: valid Unicode scalar values only; no normalization or locale folding

invariants: the policy snapshot is immutable during a scenario
nonce scope is global within the modeled namespace
receipt and event sequences are dense and append-only
one first-use receipt exists per consumed nonce
a recorded decision can be allow or deny
exact retries preserve the stored decision and mutate nothing
conflicting retries and future-epoch claims mutate nothing
a conflicting retry cannot overwrite or free a consumed nonce
matching deny rules override matching allow rules
diagnostic rule IDs use Unicode scalar ordering, never locale or UTF-16 code-unit ordering

requirements: JavaScript and Python parser classifications agree
JavaScript and Python complete scenario receipts are byte-identical
rejected and replayed actions preserve state digests
event and receipt sequences remain dense
every event corresponds to one first-use receipt

non_claims: no actor identity proof, authentication, credential, capability-token, signature, MAC, hash-proof, or trust-root validity
no durable nonce store, durable receipt store, production replay protection, or crash recovery
no transport, delivery, channel security, routing, provider, process, clock, or runtime execution behavior
no policy distribution, policy administration, production authorization, IAM, or enforcement claim
no database, consensus, federation, availability, partition tolerance, or multi-authority agreement
no compatibility claim for every current Meshfleet implementation detail
no merge, publication, deployment, activation, or release authority
